plain.li: [ward,warm,askward] We have a youth who has talked of nothing else since your letter came, {WRITER}. They will come.
[ward,warm,askward,theirLowtech] It is an honor to be asked. One of our house will come to learn from yours.
[ward,cordial,askward] Yes. Keep them busy and keep them fed, and send them home a little wiser.
[ward,cordial,askward,theirHightech] Approved. We've picked someone keen, and their family has signed off on it.
[ward,cordial,askward,call] Good to hear from you, {WRITER}. We'll send someone, and they're already packing.
[ward,cool,askward] Very well. Treat them as you would your own, and we will hear how you did.
[ward,refusal,askward] No family here will part with a child for a year, not this year.
[ward,refusal,askward,theirLowtech] The families have talked it over and none will send a youth so far.
[ward,refusal,askward,call] I'm sorry, {WRITER}. Nobody here is ready to send a youth away just now.
[ward,warm,send] Send them, {WRITER}. We will look after them as if they were born here.
[ward,cordial,send,theirLowtech] Your youth will have a place at our table and work to learn.
[ward,cordial,send,theirHightech] Accepted. We've found them a bunk and a teacher.
[ward,cool,send] They may come, and they will work like anyone else here.
[ward,refusal,send] We have no room for another youth this year, and it would not be fair to them.
[ward,refusal,send,call] Not this year, {WRITER}. We couldn't do right by them.
[ward,cordial,send,page] A titled household will take your youth as its page, and see that they are trained properly.
[ward,refusal,send,page] No household of rank has a place for a page from your colony this year.
[greetings,warm,tie:ward:theirs] Thank you for your letter, and for keeping {WARD}. Their family reads every word that reaches us.
[greetings,cordial,tie:ward:theirs] We hear {WARD} is learning, which is all we hoped for.
[greetings,cool,tie:ward:theirs] We have your letter. We would rather have word of {WARD}, if you write again.
[help,refusal,tie:ward:theirs] You already keep one of ours. That is help enough between us for now.
[greetings,warm,tie:ward:ours] {WARD} is well and working hard. You would be proud.
[greetings,cordial,tie:ward:ours,theirLowtech] {WARD} has a place at our table and keeps it well.
[news,cordial,tie:ward:ours] Here is our news. {WARD} is part of it now, and they will tell you the rest.
[greetings,cool,tie:hostage:theirs] We read your letter. Keep {HOSTAGE} well, and the terms will keep themselves.
[greetings,cordial,tie:hostage:ours] {HOSTAGE} is well and kept as the terms say. You can stop worrying.
[help,refusal,tie:hostage:theirs] One of ours lives under your roof already. Do not ask us for more.
[greetings,curt,tie:hostage:due,tie:hostage:ours] You broke your word, and we hold {HOSTAGE}. There is nothing else to write about.
[greetings,cool,tie:hostage:due,tie:hostage:theirs] We know what was done, and we know you hold {HOSTAGE}. Do what you will.
[wardlesson,us] Watch my hands, then do it after me.
[wardlesson,us] Slower, you'll get it right before you get it fast.
[wardlesson,us] That's it, keep going.
[wardlesson,us,kind] Good, you're better at this than I was at your age.
[wardlesson,us,abrasive] No, again, and pay attention this time.
[wardlearn,them] Why do you do it that way and not the other?
[wardlearn,them] Can I try it on my own now?
[wardlearn,them,theirLowtech] We do it differently at home, but I think yours is better.
[wardlearn,them,theirHightech] Is there a reason for that step, or is it just habit?
[wardmeet,them] They told me you're the one teaching me.
[wardmeet,them] I'm told I'm to learn from you.
[wardbye,them] Thank you for the year, and for your patience.
[wardbye,them] I'll tell them at home who taught me.
[wardbye,them,theirLowtech] My house will remember your name.
[wardkin,them] Look at you, a year older and taller with it.
[wardkin,them] Come on, everyone at home is waiting for you.
[wardkin,them,theirLowtech] Your family has kept your place at the table.
[hostagego,us] I'll go, if it keeps the peace.
[hostagego,us] Somebody has to, so it may as well be me.
[hostagego,us,kind] Don't worry about me, I'll be back when the term is out.
